notes: family: abstract-objective. Score = tallest stack, every disc worth 1. Wave-majority sweep of Sea discs happens before stacking (split evenly on ties, remainder stays in the Sea, nothing if no Waves). Solo mode (ends when a 7th token appears in Sea or Seaside; score bands 0-19 poor ... 60+) not modelled. Official rulebook PDF could not be downloaded; rules from Board Game Arena help page and reviews, so exact tie wording unverified.
